review_input.original_instruction: For your start point you will begin in a bathroom exit the washroom straight ahead and enter into the bedroom. You will pass a bed on your right and a desk study area to your left exit the bedroom through the open doorway and enter into the hallway. Make a left turn around the corner and look to your left you will see that there is a dark brown leather chair move towards that chair and turn around to your right. There's going to be a wall that has some family pictures on it. Move to the right of that wall and enter into a short narrow hall that bends you will then see the front door that has a circle fuzzy accent rug. Move to the right of the front door and enter into the open doorway that would lead you into a home office. Move to the right in between the desk to your left and the leather arm chair to your right move in between both sets of furniture and make your way to the wall that has that shredder. Stand in front of that shredder and you are done.
